title: f31r whole seed-extraction rite: 30 explicit values, persistent seeds and actor/recipient knowledge binding
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. New independent RAW336 descendant maps the whole 37-group f31r.1-5 paragraph to complete Cyranides I.1.36 extraction, cloth and neck-binding instructions. Thirty new whole-form values and five productions retain three THE SEEDS pairs and three YOU tokens. Two KNOWS tokens are explicitly bound to the same rite proposition/time with opposite truth values; actor knowledge is an added hypothesis, not a translation of ritual purity. Two seed-quantity scopes and all raw uncertainties remain. No semantic test was run.
parent: IDEA000336 source-only chain; no inherited target word dictionary

batch_selection.task: Develop 2-4 bounded source sketches with a genuinely different content consequence, then at most one complete target reading. The current independent family cap is <=30 new whole-form values. The closed RAW492 <=20-new-value selection is neither widened nor rerun.
sketches_compared: Cyranides I.1.36: physical extraction and cloth/neck binding with instrument, recipient-awareness and actor-purity conditions.
Galen II.44.2: former versus replacement hot water and opposing boiling policies for drying versus evacuation.
Vitruvius IX.8.9: opposite float/counterweight movement, driven axis/wheel, seasonal display and month-index holes.
batch_selection.choice: Cyranides I.1.36 is the only sketch developed into a complete target reading in this batch. It is a complete short instruction with several concrete operations and recurring participants/materials; f31r.1-5 permits a stated 30-value account with repeated THE SEEDS, YOU and KNOWS. The other sketches remain precise source-owned options, not invented new mechanisms or complete target interpretations.
batch_selection.ceiling: Source instructions and the Greek numeral do not establish the manuscript genre, any Voynich number or a medical outcome.

family_separation.meaning: This is a separate, incompatible exploratory meaning family. Identical spellings may already have other guesses in amulet/music/unweaving models; none of those entries is changed, imported or mixed here. This is not an extension of RAW486/487/492.
family_separation.individuals: All R,G,C,A,W are new variables of this proposed rite. No silent case change inside a frozen older dictionary occurs. No old engraved stone, eagle image, grape-seed individual or music participant is carried over.
family_separation.limit: The low new-value count comes from selecting a 30-form complete paragraph, not from transferring a confirmed dictionary. It gives no independent evidential advantage over an equally coherent alternative family.

selection_and_first_unfinished_attempt.new_rule: Independent new-family work uses only existing complete ZL3b paragraphs on leaves other than83/84, not f116v, with >=30 groups and <=30 exact forms. Order by groups decreasing, number of recurrent exact forms decreasing, then ID. This is a separate cap from the closed <=20-amulett-extension selection.
selection_and_first_unfinished_attempt.not_progress_claim: The arithmetic inventory only chose bounded exposed material; it is not a research result or evidence that a genre is present.
selection_and_first_unfinished_attempt.first_attempt_status: f103r.48-51 was read first. No complete source-consistent uniform assignment was finished. The four qokeey tokens include adjacent positions4/5, requiring a genuine repeated predicate/reference or clause boundary; a seed/seed restatement and forced compound macros were considered insufficiently motivated. This is a concrete unfinished binding, not proof that repetition cannot be meaningful and not a failed experiment. No first-attempt dictionary was frozen.
selection_and_first_unfinished_attempt.second_choice: f31r.1-5 was then read. Its s aiin pairs at4/5,12/13,22/23 support one explicit seed-group reference; daiin at9,18,35 supports actor identity; qokeey at16,19 supports one knowledge predicate with distinct participant arguments. This is adaptive exposed hypothesis construction, not blinded selection or a statistical comparison.
selection_and_first_unfinished_attempt.third_inspected_not_fitted: The next ranked f7v.6-9 record was also inspected for its repeat pattern (sho,daiin,dol,dor,r); no lexical account was written and it was not selected. All three inspected candidates are already in the owned packet.

exact_greek_section.text: Λαβὼν οὖν σταφίδας ἐχούσας γίγαρτα δ’ ἐκκόκισον αὐτὰ τοῖς ὄνυξι, καὶ μὴ τῷ στόματι, καὶ βαλὼν αὐτὰ εἰς ῥάκος περίαπτε τῷ τραχήλῳ ἀγνοοῦντι ἁγνὸς ὧν, καὶ ἀπαλλάξεις Θεοῦ χάριτι.

complete_selected_source.own_working_english: Therefore take raisins having four seeds; remove them with the fingernails and not with the mouth, put them into a cloth and bind it about the neck of the unknowing recipient, being pure yourself, and you will release [the recipient] by the grace of God.
complete_selected_source.source_scope: Every instruction and qualifier in section36 is mapped. Sections35 and37 are retained below as context and separate content; neither is claimed to be translated by these37 target groups. The original RAW336 whole I.1 chain remains unchanged.

context_35.text: Ἔτι δὲ λείπει μοι περὶ τίνος κακοῦ δαίμονος, ὅς ἐστιν τεταρταῖος, ὡς ἐπιπέμπεται ἀνδράσι καὶ (f. 11 v.) γυναιξίν, ὑπὸ δεκανοῦ τοῦ πρώτου αἰγοκέρω μὴ ταχέως πειθομένου, διότι οὐ βλέπει οὕτε ἀκούει, ὑπάρχει γὰρ ἀκέφαλος.

separate_statement_37.text: Καὶ ὁ λίθος ὁ ἐκ τῆς κεφαλῆς τοῦ ἰχθύος περιαπτόμενος ἀπαλλάσσει τοὺς τετραίζοντας.

scope_limits: ἀγνοοῦντι concerns the unknowing recipient; the exact object of ignorance is not supplied by this participle.
ἁγνὸς ὤν concerns the actor’s purity, not the actor’s knowledge and not the recipient’s purity.
γίγαρτα δʹ is retained as the two explicit seed-quantity scopes below; the number of raisins is unknown.
Section35 supplies the quartan/demon/first-decan-Capricorn context; it is a historical attribution, not a verified cause.
Section37 separately claims a head-of-fish stone worn as an amulet releases quartan sufferers. No such stone is silently inserted into section36.
Divine grace and relief remain attributed historical content, not scientific efficacy.

complete_clauses.working_reading: Therefore take raisins containing four seeds [total, or four in each selected raisin].
complete_clauses.reduction: TAKE(A,R); declare CONTAINS(R,G) under Q_TOTAL or Q_EACH below. THE GRAPE_SEEDS first binds G rather than presupposing old I.1.39 seed material. THEREFORE points to the immediately preceding source-context quartan discussion, not to an earlier target operation.

complete_clauses.working_reading: You extract those seeds using your fingernails, not your mouth.
complete_clauses.reduction: EXTRACT(A,G,R,instrument=NAILS(A)); PROHIBIT(EXTRACT(A,G,R,instrument=MOUTH(A))). The command has exactly one extraction event; the negative alternative is not executed. The seed members remain the same G.

complete_clauses.working_reading: You know this rite; the recipient does not know this rite.
complete_clauses.reduction: Assert KNOWS(A,P_rite,t_bind)=true and NOT(KNOWS(W,P_rite,t_bind)). The second object and time are exactly the same as the first by explicit new grammar, not a different purpose or later moment. The actor-knowledge assertion is new guessed target content; the Greek ritual purity is not evidence for it.

complete_clauses.working_reading: Place those seeds in a cloth and bind it on the recipient’s neck.
complete_clauses.reduction: PLACE(A,G,IN(G,C)); BIND(A,C,ON(C,NECK(W))). Seeds must first have been removed from R, and the cloth must contain exactly the same G before binding. The actor is A from YOU; recipient W is the person introduced in C03. No amulet A/S/I from RAW486 is reused.

complete_clauses.working_reading: While you are pure in binding, the source claims that you will release the recipient by God’s grace.
complete_clauses.reduction: Require PURE(A,t_bind), with WHILE binding back to C04 BIND. Record CLAIM(source=I.1.36, RELEASE(A,W,Q) BY_GRACE(GOD)). Q is quartan affliction from I.1.35 context. This requires no actual health-state mutation and supplies no success rate. The lexical YOU remains A, not W.

finite_grammar.productions: Exactly C01-C05 as printed, consuming7,8,6,8,8 raw groups respectively. Five freely fitted schemas, no skipped token or component rule.
finite_grammar.THE: s binds/retrieves the same seed group denoted by aiin in all three pairs. The first quantified noun phrase creates its referent from the selected raisins; the later two phrases cannot select fresh seeds.
finite_grammar.KNOWS: qokeey is KNOWS(Person,Proposition,Time) in both positions. The first phrase supplies P_rite explicitly via chey and actor A via daiin. The second supplies W via [s:r]air, uses the same P_rite/t_bind, and chekey negates that one assertion.
finite_grammar.YOU: daiin denotes the same A in all three occurrences. A is not globally identified with W; distinctness is a consequence only if the complete stated knowledge assumptions are retained.
finite_grammar.imperatives: The physical order is TAKE -> EXTRACT_WITH_NAILS -> PLACE_IN_CLOTH -> BIND_ON_NECK. Knowledge/purity are declarations at t_bind, not extra physical actions or later repairs.
finite_grammar.postposed_purity: PURE BEING WHILE in C05 modifies the immediately preceding BIND event and its actor A. It does not modify the recipient or knowledge assertion.
finite_grammar.claim_scope: ATTRIBUTED_CLAIM governs RELEASE and BY_GRACE(GOD). It records a promise about W’s quartan affliction, not the real event RELEASE or a patient-health transition.
finite_grammar.inverse: Concatenate the five explicit word lists to recover the exact raw paragraph. This only checks document coverage and does not settle uncertain letters or seams.

quantity_variants_fixed_before_any_test.Q_TOTAL: R is a nonempty finite set of selected raisins, G all selected seeds named in the description, and |G|=4. This total-cardinality reading is an explicit scope assumption, not forced by the Greek.
quantity_variants_fixed_before_any_test.Q_EACH: For every r in the nonempty selected R, its disjoint seed group G_r has four members; G is their union. |R| is unspecified. No four-raisins claim is added.
quantity_variants_fixed_before_any_test.shared: Both variants retain the very same FOUR lexical value and subsequent G identities. They change numeral/distribution scope, not instrument, knowledge, purity or binding rules.
quantity_variants_fixed_before_any_test.vacuity: With one selected raisin the two scope readings coincide and have no discriminating capacity. No numerical efficacy, dose mass or four/quartan decoding inference is made.

exact_knowledge_contract.proposition: P_rite is the one proposition: in this planned transaction, actor A extracts the selected G from R using fingernails, places that same G in cloth C, and binds C on recipient W’s neck for the historically claimed quartan-relief purpose. This proposition identifies the current plan and its purpose; it does not assert that relief actually happens.
exact_knowledge_contract.time: Both KNOWS assertions are evaluated at the same binding-event time t_bind.
exact_knowledge_contract.additional_target_assumption: Only the recipient’s being unknowing comes from the Greek. The positive actor KNOWS assertion and the shared full-rite object/time are added guesses of this target reading, counted separately from source purity.
exact_knowledge_contract.conditional_consequence: If KNOWS is a single-valued Boolean relation with ordinary identity substitution, these two assertions require A!=W. The source alone does not prove two people. A different proposition or different time would remove this simple distinctness inference.
exact_knowledge_contract.serious_scope_rival: Keep the same KNOWS word and participant nouns but let the actor know only the physical attachment procedure P_attach and the recipient be ignorant only of the therapeutic purpose P_purpose. The objects then differ, so opposite truth values alone do not establish different persons. This reading remains a real source-scope ambiguity, not a type error.

explicit_new_binding_assumptions.assumption: R,G,C,A,W are this new rite’s entities; the entire section36 target is one case. Q is the quartan condition inherited only as immediate source context from35.
Exactly the seeds selected in the initial raisins comprise G. Three THE SEEDS phrases preserve this membership through extraction and cloth placement.
Quantity has the two fixed TOTAL/EACH scopes; neither the number of raisins nor seed mass is invented.
FINGERNAILS and MOUTH belong to actor A, and NOT_USING scopes solely over EXTRACT. Forbidden mouth extraction is not executed and cannot be repaired by a later purity assertion.
THIS_RITE is the exact P_rite reference macro printed above; both KNOWS cells use the same P_rite and t_bind. The recipient ignorance object is thus more specific than the Greek alone supplies.
YOU is A throughout; actor KNOWS is a guessed additional assertion distinct from source PURE(A). No epistemic implication is inferred from ritual purity.
C04 IN binds seeds to C and ON binds the loaded C to NECK(W). The carrier of G is cloth, not the raisin or a new stone; all omitted actor/recipient arguments are uniquely supplied by A/W.
PURE is evaluated on A at BIND and is independent of knowledge, recipient purity and extraction instrument. The model must not identify ritual purity with hygiene or with the absence of mouth use.
The physical operations are instructed hypothetical actions. A trace that violates an instruction is nonconforming; this is not proof that any medical effect would fail.

The final promise records the source’s attributed RELEASE(A,W,Q) BY_GRACE(GOD). The recipient and affliction arguments are implicit source-context references, not whole-sentence meanings hidden inside YOU.
THEREFORE supplies a source-context discourse connection to35; it does not import an independently confirmed astronomical mechanism or force section37’s different stone into the same case.

physical_and_claim_contract.initial: Selected R contains G under either quantity scope. Cloth C is loose and available. A is actor; W is recipient. No seed has yet been extracted or placed/bound. Required actor purity and knowledge/ignorance are input declarations at t_bind; no medical efficacy state is initialized.
physical_and_claim_contract.TAKE: Make R available to A; retain membership/identity.
physical_and_claim_contract.EXTRACT: Require G contained in R and instrument NAILS(A); move the same seed identities out of R into A’s loose working material. MOUTH(A) is expressly prohibited for this action.
physical_and_claim_contract.PLACE: Require the same G extracted and C available; set contents(C)=G. Introduce no new seeds and preserve the selected numeral scope.
physical_and_claim_contract.BIND: Require contents(C)=G, target NECK(W), actor A and PURE(A,t_bind); attach C to that neck. The C03 knowledge declarations must simultaneously hold. No physiological change follows.
physical_and_claim_contract.CLAIM: Append the source-attributed promise with W,Q and GOD-grace qualifier. A valid instruction trace can license the attributed statement; the record is not observed relief.
physical_and_claim_contract.knowledge: Use one Boolean KNOWS relation. No closed-world inference, omniscience, automatic knowledge of all facts, knowledge from purity or transfer of knowledge between persons is assumed.
physical_and_claim_contract.participant_identity_gate: A and W are initially role variables that may in principle name the same person. Their role distinction is not an axiom A!=W. Only the simultaneously asserted main KNOWS facts with identical P_rite/t_bind derive distinct physical persons; the different-proposition rival need not do so.

concrete_new_consequences_and_scope: Extracting G from R changes its location/containment, then the same G enters C and reaches W’s neck. This is a new material history and case, not a restatement of the old engraved amulet plan.

The positive and negative knowledge assertions constrain the same operation/proposition/time through two written qokeey occurrences; ordinary identity substitution then excludes A=W under the main added bindings.
Actor purity and recipient ignorance attach to different argument roles; switching either to the other participant can alter whether the full instruction is conforming for a given pair of people.
The extraction-instrument restriction and later purity condition are independent: a pure actor using the mouth still violates the explicit extraction instruction.
The two number scopes alter how many seed individuals must survive extraction and placement when more than one raisin is selected; with one raisin they coincide. No success quantity is inferred.

fixed_rivals_and_retained_countercases.R_KNOWLEDGE_OBJECT: The serious P_attach/P_purpose knowledge-scope rival is specified in exact_knowledge_contract. It can remove the main A!=W inference while preserving a source-compatible ignorance statement. No source-based verdict against it is claimed.
fixed_rivals_and_retained_countercases.R_PURITY_RECIPIENT: Keep all30 word values and other bindings, but attach the PURE predicate to W rather than A. For A pure/W not pure, main permits that property assignment and the rival rejects it; reversing those two purity values reverses this local prediction. The Greek masculine actor participle supports A, but target attachment is still guessed.
fixed_rivals_and_retained_countercases.R_SAME_PARTICIPANT: Identify A=W while retaining the main shared P_rite/t_bind and opposite Boolean knowledge assertions. The resulting contradiction is predicted from the added target assumptions, not a new historical discovery or independent proof from the source.
fixed_rivals_and_retained_countercases.R_MOUTH_INSTRUMENT: The source explicitly rules out mouth extraction. A trace using the mouth violates C02 even if cloth placement, recipient ignorance and actor purity otherwise hold. This retained direct countercase tests full argument ownership, not a newly learned manuscript rule.
fixed_rivals_and_retained_countercases.quantity: Q_TOTAL and Q_EACH are co-retained interpretations, not a positive versus negative score choice. Their equal one-raisin case is vacuous for quantifier discrimination.
fixed_rivals_and_retained_countercases.IT: The complete IT35-group paragraph has several different forms/seams and cannot be parsed by these fixed ZL37-group schemas without new assumptions. No shadow dictionary or per-occurrence repair is supplied.
fixed_rivals_and_retained_countercases.source_and_freedom: Thirty whole-word guesses plus five fitted productions and eleven binding assumptions can build a coherent story without identifying manuscript meaning. The added actor-knowledge assertion is specifically not source-attested. The parent I.1 chain, 24-roster/760-body countercase, and other meaning families remain unchanged.

compound_reference_costs: THIS_RITE names the complete stated plan proposition and purpose, rather than an elementary object.
BY_GRACE is one historical agency qualifier.
fitting_freedom.raw_unknowns: Three unresolved raw groups receive guesses only as full raw tokens; their underlying letters remain unresolved. No generic decoder or substring lexicon is supplied.

decision_note.unknown: Whether this entire fixed target account preserves the three seed-group references and the actor/recipient/instrument/purity scopes under a complete derivation, rather than merely producing an English synopsis.
decision_note.smallest_later_check: If root selects it, inspect the complete five-clause derivation, both quantity scopes, and the same/different person and purity-role cases with the exact knowledge proposition/time. A source-only success or a failed same-person definition is insufficient; report the whole reading’s consistency and unresolved knowledge-scope rival. No broad grammar builder is required.
decision_note.outcomes: An unresolvable repeated-value/argument conflict rejects this exact descendant; a coherent account retains one unconfirmed full reading. Coherence of the different-knowledge-object rival limits the inferred participant distinction. Neither outcome translates a word.

Targeted proposal search found a literal dar occurrence in DITTO_FULL_CENSUS at f31r.4 and older selection-table exposure; these provide neither this full lexical account nor confirmed dar meaning.
